$comment: What: template for the shared UAT environment (CCE services reached directly, never through the gateway, which rate-limits /v1/events). How: copy to uat.json, replace every REPLACE-ME host, then run e.g. scripts/check-services.sh uat; uat.json may be committed when it holds no secrets, personal overrides go in uat.local.json (git-ignored). Needs: network access from the k6 host to every service, Kafka and Postgres; DB_PASSWORD exported; team agreement before enabling allowTempIndex or allowPlanDefinitionChanges. services.stepSla.pollIntervalSeconds must match the Step SLA poll interval actually deployed (CCE_SLA_POLL_INTERVAL_MS / 1000): 15 here because deploy-scripts start the service with the prod profile (application-prod.yml, 15000 ms); use 5 only if it runs the default profile (application.yml, 5000 ms). Preflight step-sla-scheduler waits pollIntervalSeconds + 2 s for a scheduler cycle and STEP_SLA_MAX_WAIT=auto is 2 x this value, so too small a value reports a healthy scheduler as stopped. Outputs: read by tools/core/environment.mjs.
name: uat
description: UAT environment: copy to uat.json and fill the hosts (k6 on its own host, not a laptop)
